metadata.target_role: Project Executive - PMO Center of Excellence

red_flags.detail: PMP is explicitly required by the JD; resume lists it only as 'initiated' (not held).
JD phrases (Master Project Templates, Schedule Audits, EVM, PSA, Power BI/Tableau, training) appear in Skills with no supporting experience bullets; reads as keyword mirroring.

ringldr is a consultancy but headline bullet is an 'internal' framework; no clients, baselines or sample size for the +22%/-18% results. Headline implies executive title never held. 'Healthcare IT 10+ years' claim is arguable.
Vanyshr uses year-only dates while other roles use Month YYYY; ringldr/GEHA/Cornerstones overlap may confuse chronological parsing.

parsing_risks: DATE RISK (minor): Vanyshr year-only dates vs Month YYYY elsewhere
CHRONOLOGY RISK (minor): overlapping concurrent roles; ringldr (2018) listed above Cornerstones (2019)

must_haves: Bachelor's degree in Business, PM, Engineering, IS or related field (candidate has Psychology/Sociology BS plus MSW)
10+ years managing detailed master project schedules (about 5-6 years evidenced; strongest evidence 8+ years old)
preferred: Implementing or optimizing PSA and resource management processes
Evaluating and implementing project management technologies and reporting solutions
Advanced executive dashboards and project performance reporting frameworks

priority_actions.description: Resolve the PMP gap: obtain the PMP before applying, or state a verifiable exam/approval status and address in cover note.
Add quantified experience bullets (if true) for schedule audits, EVM/percent-complete, PM training, dashboards, PSA and tool evaluation; remove skills that cannot be evidenced.
Rewrite Netsmart bullets (150+ EHR projects, master schedules, 3,000+ hour implementation) to include real outcomes such as on-time delivery, slippage reduction or resource conflict reduction.
Reframe the 10+ years claim honestly (total delivery years vs schedule-ownership years) and expand the Netsmart section.
priority_actions.expected_ats_impact: Reduces recruiter reject risk; minimal direct ATS change

priority_actions.description: Name ringldr client types, baselines and scope; clarify 'internal' framework; temper 'Executive' headline; trim irrelevant Vanyshr security-gate detail; normalize Vanyshr dates.
priority_actions.expected_ats_impact: Integrity CONCERNS -> PASS; minor ATS change
